title: Model Horizon Scout: Operational Guide for Tracking Provider Availability & Competitive Signals
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Build an operational playbook and lightweight pipeline to surface short-term (0-90 day) availability, pricing, and quality signals for open and hosted model providers so sales/solutions and infra can proactively plan fallbacks and procurement. Deliverables: 1) A cadence and data contract for the Model Horizon feed (daily availability, median p95 latency by region, quantization/precision variants online, published pricing changes); 2) A living dashboard with alerting thresholds for supply shocks; 3) A prioritized handler runbook for short-term mitigation (route to dedicated pool, auto-fallback model mapping, customer communication templates). Scope: Focus on provider-level signals (hosted open models, large vendor endpoints, regional edge availability) and on metrics that materially affect Redwood’s inference economics: latency percentiles, burst capacity availability, published price deltas, and observed regression in embeddings similarity for benchmark cue sets. Out of scope for this ticket: deep per-model quality research or proprietary vendor contract negotiations (will be separate follow-ups). Success metrics: feed coverage >= 80% of top-20 providers by business exposure, median freshness <= 24 hours, and three simulated supply-shock drills executed with playbook and runbook within ETA.

Why now: Several recent enterprise RFPs require documented fallback readiness and a vendor-availability SLA map. Proactive signal detection reduces emergency procurements and customer disruptions.
acceptance_criteria: Daily automated ingestion for top-20 model endpoints with schema validated (availability, latency_p50_p95, variant_list, price_change_pct)
Dashboard with time-series and region filters deployed to Console beta and accessible to GTM (link to dashboard in comments)
Alert rules for >25% region availability drop or >30% price increase with triage tickets created automatically
Runbook with step-by-step mitigation mapped to Redwood products (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and tested in 3 tabletop drills
